attributes.action: Create harsher punishments for this convicted of animal abuse
attributes.additional_details: Animals have been with us history weather that be helping plough the fields, providing fertilisers to help crops grow, messages during the wars, rescue animals, or just simply there to help comfort individuals who are struggling with their mental health. Animals do not have a voice they can’t call for help or tell someone that they are scared or in pain. It is time for us to start giving back to the animals that helped us survive let’s be the voice for the voiceless and protect our animals.
attributes.background: Human life isn’t more valuable then any other life that is on this planet we need harsher laws to protect our animals from cruel inhumane individuals that wish them harm where perpetrators are held accountable for there actions and face the same harsh consequences that any other abuser faces

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Require immediate custodial sentences for animal abuse, cruelty & neglect
